svg.title: Training Harbour, a fictional training chart
svg.desc: A made-up chart of a harbour with a mainland coast to the north, Pine Island and Gull Rock, Sentinel Rock that dries, Mercy Shoal, two lights, a beacon and a fairway buoy. Fictional, not for navigation.
svg.text: A fictional place for chartwork practice
Depths in metres below chart datum.
Fictional training chart. Not for navigation. Positions, depths and hazards are invented. NauticleBC study aid.
